Build passes now, 0 errors. The rest of the log (deprecation notices, dedupe lines, etc.) is genuinely just noise from the version bump — no action needed there.

Two real bugs, both from shape/default changes the bump introduced that weren't propagated to these call sites:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — bundler now passes `retryCount` instead of `retries`; call site still read the old key and crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`; the strict check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on `undefined`. Treated `undefined` as `false` (backoff off by default), matching old behavior.
